description: List all monitors associated with your API key. Supports pagination and filtering by status.

limit.description: Maximum number of monitors to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Number of monitors to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0.

name: list_monitors

outputSchema.description: A page of the account's rate monitors, with counts.

monitors.description: The monitors on this page (a condensed view — call get_monitor for full conditions).

conditions_count.description: How many trigger conditions the monitor has.

last_triggered_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last trigger, null if never.

summary.description: Human-readable count of total, active, and paused monitors.
